## Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know about Paxper

What is visual infrastructure as code?

Visual infrastructure as code means designing cloud resources on a diagram and having the tool generate standard infrastructure-as-code configuration. Paxper generates standard OpenTofu configurations, so the output stays portable, and every change is reviewed before it is applied.

What is Paxper?

Paxper gives your team a visual workspace to design cloud infrastructure, review proposed changes, and manage resources in your own cloud account.

Which cloud providers are supported?

Paxper currently supports AWS. Connect your account with an access key or an IAM role, then start designing in a workspace. [...] Do I need coding experience to use Paxper?

No. Design your cloud setup visually, review the proposed changes in plain language, and apply them when they look right.

How does the AI assistant work?

Paxy and AI Analyze help you understand your workspace, explore your infrastructure, and get help interpreting deployment issues.

Is my infrastructure data secure?

Security is our top priority. Data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256. Your cloud credentials are encrypted at rest and never stored in plain text.
